settings.text: Choose your build and add it to your cart.
Pick Affirm at checkout and select your monthly terms.
Get a quick decision — ride now, pay over time.
Start the quick Truemed eligibility check.
If eligible, receive a Letter of Medical Necessity.
Pay with your HSA/FSA card — or reimburse yourself, pre-tax.

settings.question: Can I really use my HSA/FSA on a bike?
settings.answer: In many cases, yes. Truemed evaluates eligibility and, where appropriate, issues a Letter of Medical Necessity so you can use pre-tax funds. Eligibility is individual — Truemed confirms it.

settings.question: What happens at checkout?
settings.answer: Choose Affirm to pay monthly, or use your HSA/FSA card after completing Truemed's eligibility step. Standard returns still apply.

settings.question: Is the monthly estimate a quote?
settings.answer: No. On-page figures are illustrative. Your real rate and terms come from Affirm at checkout.

settings.heading: Ride now, pay monthly — or use pre-tax dollars.
settings.subheading: A new bike is more attainable than the sticker suggests. Here's how real riders actually pay for one.
settings.hero_example: Entry Level SP starts as low as $130/mo with Affirm — Or Save 30% when you pay with pre-tax with your HSA/FSA.
settings.affirm_text: Affirm splits your purchase into predictable monthly payments. Choose your terms at checkout — no surprises.
settings.affirm_example: See your estimated monthly payment at checkout.
settings.truemed_heading: Buy your bike with pre-tax dollars
settings.truemed_text: With a Letter of Medical Necessity through Truemed, an eligible bike can be purchased with HSA/FSA funds — using pre-tax money is effectively a discount of roughly 30%.
settings.calc_subheading: Pick a build to see an illustrative monthly payment and pre-tax cost.
settings.calc_disclaimer: Illustrative estimates only — not an offer of credit, a quote, or tax advice. Your actual terms, eligibility and savings will differ.
settings.final_heading: Find the build that fits your budget
settings.final_text: Four groupsets, four price points. Pick yours and see the monthly or pre-tax number.
settings.email_text: We'll send a plain-English financing + HSA/FSA breakdown you can come back to.
